events.title: Roswell UFO Crash
events.evidence: On July 8, 1947, the Roswell Army Air Field public information office in Roswell, New Mexico, reported the crash and recovery of a 'flying disc.'

events.title: The Department of Defense establishes AARO
events.evidence: On July 20, 2022, the Department of Defense established the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office to study, collect data, and report on UAP.

events.title: The New York Times publishes its investigation of the Pentagon's UFO program
events.evidence: On Saturday, December 16, 2017, their story appeared online; it was printed on the front page the next day.

events.title: ODNI submits the 2022 Annual Report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena
events.evidence: On January 12, 2023, the ODNI submitted the 2022 Annual Report on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena.

events.title: AARO's FY2023 consolidated UAP report is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena; cleared for open publication Oct 17, 2023.

events.title: AARO launches its public website and secure reporting mechanism
events.evidence: On October 31, 2023, AARO launched the aaro.mil website, featuring a secure mechanism for authorized reporting.

events.title: AARO's Historical Record Report, Volume I, is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Report on the Historical Record of U.S. Government Involvement with UAP, Volume I; cleared for open publication Mar 06, 2024.

events.title: AARO's FY2024 consolidated UAP report is cleared for open publication
events.evidence: Fiscal Year 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena; cleared for open publication Nov 07, 2024.

events.title: Kenneth Arnold Mount Rainier Sighting
events.evidence: On June 24, 1947, pilot Kenneth Arnold reported seeing nine objects near Mount Rainier.

events.title: Captain Mantell UFO Pursuit
events.evidence: On January 7, 1948, National Guard pilot Captain Thomas Mantell was killed while attempting to chase an unidentified object.

events.title: Lubbock Lights
events.evidence: On August 25, 1951, four Texas Tech professors observed lights crossing the sky near Lubbock.

events.title: Washington, D.C. Radar-Visual Sightings
events.evidence: On July 19, 1952, radar operators and controllers at Washington National Airport reported unexplained targets and lights.

events.title: Betty and Barney Hill Encounter
events.evidence: On September 19, 1961, Betty and Barney Hill reported an encounter while driving home to Portsmouth, New Hampshire.

events.title: Socorro UFO Landing
events.evidence: On April 24, 1964, a police officer near Socorro, New Mexico, reported an unidentified object rising from the ground.

events.title: Tehran F-4 UFO Intercept
events.evidence: On September 19, 1976, Iranian authorities scrambled an F-4 after reports of a bright unidentified object over Tehran.

events.title: Rendlesham Forest Incident
events.evidence: On December 26, 1980, personnel were called to the reported UFO landing scene in Rendlesham Forest near RAF Woodbridge.

events.title: Cash–Landrum Encounter
events.evidence: On December 29, 1980, Betty Cash, Vickie Landrum, and Colby Landrum reported an encounter near Huffman, Texas.

events.title: Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 Encounter
events.evidence: On November 17, 1986, the crew of Japan Air Lines Flight 1628 reported unidentified traffic near their Boeing 747 over Alaska.

events.title: Belgian UFO Wave Begins
events.evidence: The Belgian UFO wave began on November 29, 1989 and later included an F-16 radar investigation.

events.title: Phoenix Lights
events.evidence: On March 13, 1997, witnesses reported a UFO sighting over Phoenix, Arizona.

events.title: USS Nimitz Tic Tac Encounter
events.evidence: The main USS Nimitz Tic Tac incident occurred on November 14, 2004.

events.title: Stephenville Lights
events.evidence: FAA records document the Stephenville Lights reports of January 8, 2008.
